notes:
{発掘|はっくつ} primarily means archaeological excavation, but is also commonly used figuratively for discovering hidden talent or facts.

WRITING:
- ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, emit, departure)
- {掘|くつ} (dig)

USAGE:
- {発掘|はっくつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to excavate, to discover - suru verb)
- {発掘|はっくつ}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (excavation survey)
- {発掘|はっくつ}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ (excavation site)
- Entertainment: finding new artists or performers
- Business: discovering hidden talent in the workforce
- Journalism: uncovering previously unknown information

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発掘|はっくつ} (excavation of ruins)
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧{発掘|はっくつ} (talent discovery)
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧{発掘|はっくつ} (discovering newcomers)
- {発掘|はっくつ}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (excavated items)
